summary: Added capture preference JSON codec and settings adapter. Version-1 postCapture envelope strictly validates all five booleans, enforces 16,384-byte UTF-8 input/output limits, avoids truthy coercion, and returns immutable owned values. Legacy adapter uses PostCapture defaults with AppSettings.showPreview unless an explicit boolean override is provided. Added exports and README.
